cluster_reason: DeleteOption and its concrete implementation StandardDeleteOption form a small, cohesive interface-implementation pair with direct dependencies between them (StandardDeleteOption -> DeleteOption). They are less central than utilities like PathUtils or Counters and moving both together keeps the contract and implementation colocated, minimizing package-private exposure to remaining classes.

blocks.goal: Move the selected cluster of delete-related classes into a new subpackage to isolate delete strategy logic.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move the DeleteOption interface to the delete subpackage alongside its implementations.
Move the StandardDeleteOption implementation to the delete subpackage so the interface and implementation remain colocated.

After moving the whole cluster to the destination package, update only the minimum required visibility in moved classes and related remaining classes so the project can compile. Do not change behavior. Do not move additional classes.
